author: cens0r3d
install_msg: fakemessage loaded. Use `/fakemessage` or `[p]fakemessage @user <text>`. Run `[p]slash enablecog fakemessage` and then `[p]slash sync` to publish the slash command. The bot needs Attach Files, and the host needs Pillow (`[p]pipinstall pillow`).
name: fakemessage
description: Renders one message as a Discord dark-theme screenshot: avatar, role colour, BOT tag, markdown, mentions, links and emoji. Pillow draws it at 2x and downsamples once, so the text and avatar edges stay clean.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any user data. Avatars and emoji are fetched while a command runs and cached as pictures; nothing is tied to a user id.
